title: Detective: A Modern Crime Board Game
subtitle: A cooperative modern police procedural deduction game driven by forensic casework and the online Antares database
tagline: Follow leads, analyze evidence, and break the 4th wall to uncover a sprawling conspiracy
loreSummary: You are investigators working for the Antares National Investigation Agency, equipped with cutting-edge laboratory tools, biometric databases, and classic gumshoe instinct. What begins as a routine inquiry into a stolen antique quickly spirals into a dark, multi-decade conspiracy where every lead consumed costs precious time.
keyFeatures: Groundbreaking companion website (Antares Database) providing realistic suspect profiles, lab forensics, and DNA matches
Tight resource and time management requiring hard choices about which investigative leads to pursue
Interconnected 5-case campaign meta-plot where earlier discoveries directly influence future cases
Boundary-breaking investigation encouraging the use of real-world internet research, maps, and historical facts

detective_core_campaign.name: The Antares Campaign (Cases 1–5)
detective_core_campaign.description: The complete core box narrative arc following 5 interconnected investigations from the initial Richmond theft to the full conspiracy resolution (approx. 5 cases).

detective_prologue_arc.name: Introductory Inquiries (Cases 1–2)
detective_prologue_arc.description: A focused initial investigation encompassing the introductory stolen watch inquiry and the historical archival follow-up (approx. 2 cases).

detective_complete_dossier.name: Master Investigator Archive (Base + Bonus Cases)
detective_complete_dossier.description: The complete investigative portfolio combining the 5-case core campaign with standalone bonus cases and expansion inquiries (approx. 8 cases).

milestones.title: The Golden Watch
milestones.phase: Antares Phase I - The Initial Incident
milestones.description: Investigating the stolen golden artifact from a Richmond antique shop, collecting physical evidence, and logging the first leads into the Antares Database.

milestones.title: Ashes of the Past
milestones.phase: Antares Phase II - The Paper Trail
milestones.description: Examining forensic records and historical archives, uncovering unexpected connections linking contemporary crimes to covert wartime operations.

milestones.title: The Web Expands
milestones.description: Following suspect movements, conducting tense interrogations, and pinning together complex international relationships on the evidence corkboard.

milestones.title: Against the Clock
milestones.description: Racing against strict departmental deadlines and mounting authority scrutiny as the web of deceit tightens around key persons of interest.

milestones.title: The Final Report
milestones.phase: Antares Phase V - Closing the Conspiracy
milestones.description: Synthesizing forensic findings across all five investigations, submitting the definitive dossier to headquarters, and cracking the multi-decade conspiracy.
